recipes.name: TreeLearn evaluation
metrics: Detection: completeness, omission error, commission error, F1
Segmentation: mean precision, recall and coverage (IoU)
blockers: No validated container image or pinned code commit registered
Input/configuration adapter and output paths must be validated against a pinned upstream version

caveats.text: Unlabeled points belonging to annotated trees can penalize segmentation scores. Keep the evaluator’s boundary and commission-error rules when comparing results.
Ground-truth and predictions must share coordinates. Evaluation propagates predictions to reference points; the authors recommend 0.1 m voxel sampling.
Wytham exports overlap the acquired TLS benchmark. Do not interpret those datasets as independent training and test sites.
The evaluator writes results beside the predictions. An adapter must redirect those outputs before use with read-only dataset mounts.

recipes.audit_status: Upstream documentation reviewed; paper-wide critique and independent reproduction pending

protocol.matching: Hungarian matching; minimum IoU 0.5 in upstream example
protocol.split: Explicit site-disjoint split and model exposure review required; not imposed by the evaluator

recipes.name: ForestFormer3D
metrics: Published instance and semantic segmentation protocol; adapter pending
blockers: Pinned image, weights, preprocessing and evaluator adapter are not validated
Requires a compatible NVIDIA CUDA execution host

caveats.text: The upstream setup documents dependency repairs, configuration changes and additional inference passes for dense plots. These settings must be recorded per run.
The official split supports published-score comparison; it does not establish strict geographic independence. Never replace missing ground truth with dummy labels when scoring.

recipes.audit_status: Installation and inference documentation reviewed; complete article audit and independent reproduction pending
